problem: The projection of the intersection between the hyperbolic paraboloid $z=-9{x}^{2}+(y+3)^{2}$, and the plane $z=4$ onto the $xy$-plane is a hyperbola. Find the center of this hyperbola.

feedback.problem: What is the trace in the $xz$-plane of the elliptic paraboloid $z-1=\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $xz$-plane, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the paraboloid, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}z-1 & =\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{{0}^{2}}{2} \\ z-1 & =\frac{{x}^{2}}{4} \\ z & =\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+1\end{aligned}
$$

 

This gives us the equation of the parabola in $xz$-plane.
